set.body: From the table-role work (p0-tablerole 44ed2942). The Results board shows the selected participant's row pinned above all other rows with the annotation 'pinned · selected'. Decision (lead, 2026-10-05): option (a). A selected row is shown once, pinned at the top with that annotation, and not duplicated in its sorted position. The table's row and column counts, the cursor model and the accessibility row indices count the pinned row as row 1. Deselecting returns it to sorted order. Test the order, the cursor and the TABLE_VIEW indices.
set.title: Tables: 'pinned · selected' row at the top (Results board)
